==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Moiraine Damodred]]}}

[[Moiraine]] begins searching the rougher parts of [[Chachin]] for [[Siuan]]. Moiraine thinks Siuan must have looked for the cheapest inns to save money. At an inn called [[The Ruffled Goose]] a woman tries to steal [[Arrow (Moiraine)|Arrow]], but Moiraine is alerted thanks to her placed [[Ward]]. At [[The Blind Pig]] she is laughed at by an innkeeper. At [[The Silver Penny]], the innkeeper [[Nedare Satarov]] tries to slip her drugged wine but Moiraine realizes something is wrong. Moiraine places a weave on her, a [[Blue Ajah]] secret, that induces fear and makes her drink her own drugged wine. Moiraine spends the rest of the day searching, but cannot find Siuan. She survives more attempts to drug her and to steal Arrow.

As evening falls Siuan finally finds her. She is staying at [[The Evening Star]] which is actually a decent inn filled with merchants. The innkeeper, [[Ailene Tolvina]], allows Moiraine to share Siuan's room. Moiraine tells her friend that [[Avene Sahera]]'s son is not the [[Dragon Reborn]]. Siuan responds by saying [[Ines Demain]] is staying at the [[Aesdaishar Palace]]. She has just become a widow. She named her son Rahien, which means "dawn" in the [[Old Tongue]], because as he was born she saw dawn come up over [[Dragonmount]]. The rumors are that a very lucky blacksmith mysteriously died a few days ago. Even though the death is highly suspicious, the [[Aes Sedai]] cannot connect his murder to the [[Black Ajah]]. Moiraine has a plan to enter the Aesdaishar Palace, which Siuan does not like one bit. The good news is [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu|Ethenielle]]'s [[Aes Sedai]] advisor is away.
